patch.value: Compare native and published crash recovery with a reusable kill corpus

Reusable TypeScript process-kill/restart differential SDK and command against the locked published oracle; compare acknowledged durable bytes, append-only histories and restart receipts on disposable plain-directory trackers.

Every declared crash boundary preserves acknowledged writes; failures retain minimized synthetic reproductions and never rewrite original history.; Typed SDK and CLI with bounded TOON/JSON receipts and actionable refusals; documented example; public tracker read-copy validation with measured counts; exact-head CI release-check passes.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Overlap recheck: published CLI 2026.10.21 matches the locked oracle. Native tests cover normal command differentials and manually reconstructed durable journals; they do not run a reusable live kill/restart corpus. pm-ops assurance reports measurements; pm-vcs writer publication is backend-specific. This feature adds cross-implementation crash evidence beyond lock/parity work. Reconciliation PR 103 closures and performance PR 102 items are excluded. TypeScript-only SDK/command; synthetic failures; targeted local checks; full gate in CI.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implemented the typed TypeScript SDK and standalone just crash CLI. Declared boundaries are all observed rename/fsync task-local ordinals: event-loop write calls were rejected as unstable storage boundaries after real tracing. Two mutation families run on disposable non-git clones; same-family restart checks exact durable bytes and raw per-runtime restart receipts, with explicit shared cross-runtime acknowledgement projections. Synthetic probing measured 20 real kills, 20 preserved acknowledged writes/history prefixes, two successful baseline byte/acknowledgement comparisons and two early native lock-initialization restart refusals. Those refusals are retained as minimal one-item synthetic cases; no original stream is repaired. Full runtime crash conformance is not claimed. Adding independent replay/no-git regressions and public-copy measurements before CI.
